# OpenVSP (vendored distribution)

Not on PyPI. Download the official Ubuntu 24.04 package from
[openvsp.org/download.php](https://openvsp.org/download.php):

```text
https://openvsp.org/download.php?file=zips/current/linux/OpenVSP-3.51.0-Ubuntu-24.04_amd64.deb
```

From the repo root:

```bash
make install-openvsp
```

Extracted tree, `.deb`, and vendored `libcminpack` are gitignored; only this
README is tracked.
